baseline_models.mechanism: Return after departure combines with general likeness and open-ended duration: the ban reaches re-entry into any recognizably analogous act, not only a verbatim replay of one episode.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure makes recurrence, rather than a first occurrence, the verbal core.
General likeness widens the object from the same incident to analogous instances.
Long duration leaves no future interval in which analogous recurrence becomes harmless.

changed_reading.after: Never re-enter any act that reproduces the episode's operative pattern.

baseline_models.mechanism: Return can become habit and likeness can become imitation; the heart-directed warning interrupts a repeatable social script before rehearsal turns it into normal conduct.

activation_trace.role: A fear-tinged reminder that softens the heart supplies the interruption mechanism.
Habit, practice, and persistence expose the danger of recurrence becoming a settled disposition.
Imitation and following a model make similar conduct reproducible by others.

changed_reading.before: Avoid doing the same wrong again.
changed_reading.after: Do not rehearse, normalize, or imitate the wrong into a recurring social script.

baseline_models.mechanism: The condition joins actual being with both trusting assent and heart-security; faith is tested by whether nonrecurrence becomes a trustworthy social state rather than remaining a claimed identity.

activation_trace.role: Actual occurrence and presence make the condition about manifested being, not a detached label.
Security, trust, and freedom from fear supply the social effect faith should create.
Heart-settled assent preserves the ordinary credal force while linking it to conduct.

changed_reading.before: If you believe, comply with this warning.
changed_reading.after: If faith is truly present, enact it by refusing recurrence and becoming a source of trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence decomposes the wrong into a transmission circuit: report-flow, reception, oral output, diffusion, and stepwise following. Returning to its like therefore includes reoccupying any relay position, even without originating or repeating the identical wording.

activation_trace.role: Return anchors the model in renewed participation.
Likeness lets functionally equivalent relay acts count together.
A report expanding and flowing outward supplies the circuit's spreading medium.
Taking in transmitted speech marks reception as an active relay stage.
Opening the mouth in speech converts received material into renewed output.
Diffusion and dispersal identify circulation itself as part of the harm.
Tracing an effect step after step supplies the relay's imitative continuation.
Followable tracks make small successive participations one path.

structural_cues: 24:14-15 moves from pouring into the matter to receiving it with tongues and speaking it with mouths.
24:19 names spread as the desired outcome, while 24:21 immediately recasts continuation as following successive steps.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered reception, output, diffusion, and footsteps; I supply the arrow that each station reproduces the same mechanism. A live narrower alternative limits return to uttering the original accusation.

changed_reading.after: Do not re-enter the slander's relay system as receiver, repeater, amplifier, or follower.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing is separated from warranted assertion by good presumption, knowledgeable witness, and admitted lack of knowledge; later, faithful hearing terminates in obedience. The warning installs an evidentiary gate between receiving speech and recirculating it.

activation_trace.role: Admonition supplies the corrective input meant to change later response.
Settled assent anchors the gate in the verse's condition of faith.
Bare auditory receipt is the input that still requires judgment.
The bad-suspicion branch marks the prejudicial inference that good presumption must block.
Testimony as declaration from knowledge supplies the threshold for assertion.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower is explicitly absent from the circulating claim.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the faithful alternative to passive relay.
Obedient yielding is the output proper to hearing divine judgment.

structural_cues: 24:12 and 24:16 repeat the counterfactual moment 'when you heard it' and prescribe a different response.
24:13's witnesses and 24:15's lack of knowledge contrast evidence with mouth-level assertion.
24:51 defines the believers' speech as hearing followed by obedience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, presumption, testimony, absent knowledge, and obedient hearing; I arrange them as a gate from input to warranted output. The live alternative is that these are adjacent legal and ethical commands without one protocol.

changed_reading.before: Do not utter that false claim again.
changed_reading.after: Do not again convert heard material into assertion unless it passes the surah's knowledge-and-witness gate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Believers are told to treat the implicated community as their own self, while diffusion operates inside that believing body; the later faith/security pair makes refusal of recurrence a way to produce communal trust rather than fear.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust open a social reading of the faith condition.
The self as a thing's own identity makes fellow believers one implicated social self.
Diffusion shows how harm moves through and fragments that shared body.
One occurrence record spans believing and security, sharpening faith as a trust-producing condition.

structural_cues: 24:12 says believing men and women should think good concerning 'themselves.'
24:19 locates the desired spread inside those who believe.
24:55 places belief and the replacement of fear by security in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective-self grammar, internal spread, and a shared faith/security root; I infer that rumor recurrence destroys the security believers should generate. The alternative keeps 24:55's security as a separate promised condition.

changed_reading.before: Believers should personally refrain from repetition.
changed_reading.after: Believers prove faith by protecting the shared self from fear-producing circulation and restoring trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly places open-ended bars beside reform, protective forgiveness, purification, and erasure. This scopes 'never' to recurrence of the act while preserving a path of repair for the person.

activation_trace.role: Return identifies the permanently barred object as renewed action.
Open duration gives the act-bar its uncompromising temporal scope.
A second 'ever' creates the nearby legal contrast that the next ayah qualifies with repentance and reform.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies a changed future for the offender.
Protective covering of fault prevents permanent identity-collapse into the offense.
Purification and rectification supply the positive alternative to following recurrence.
Leaving punishment and effacing fault preserve interpersonal repair after the prohibition.

structural_cues: 24:4 says testimony is not accepted ever, and 24:5 immediately opens an exception through repentance and reform.
24:17's 'ever' governs returning to the like, while 24:20-22 continue with grace, mercy, purification, pardon, and forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permanent wording attached to acts and nearby repair sequences; I infer a scope distinction between an unending ban on recurrence and a reparable person. A live alternative treats each legal exception as local and imports no general scope principle.

changed_reading.before: The offenders are permanently marked by what happened.
changed_reading.after: The analogous act is permanently barred, but people remain addressable by admonition, reform, purification, and pardon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The house-entry rules distinguish intrusive re-entry from a commanded return away from a denied threshold. Read back into the focus, nonreturn is directional: faith refuses renewed entry into the harmful pattern, while retreat from it is itself purifying.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure anchors the directional contrast.
Likeness defines the harmful space whose threshold must not be crossed again.
Entry into an interior supplies the threshold structure.
Permission determines whether crossing the boundary is legitimate.
Returning away from an improper course supplies the commanded opposite of harmful return.
Purity marks respectful retreat as positive rather than mere absence.

structural_cues: 24:27-28 forbids entry before a social threshold is cleared.
When entry is refused, the doubled command to return is called purer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a literal household threshold, permission, retreat, and purity; I extend that structure to the entry of harmful speech into a social interior. The live alternative confines the sequence to privacy law.

changed_reading.before: All return language simply intensifies abstention.
changed_reading.after: Do not return toward the harmful pattern; instead practice the purifying return that withdraws when a boundary bars entry.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later co-occurrence of clarified signs, an example, and admonition makes the focus warning an act of exemplarization: the episode is rendered legible as a transferable pattern so that analogous recurrence can be recognized in advance.

activation_trace.role: Heart-affecting admonition is the focus verse's pedagogical action.
An example as lesson or sign lets 'its like' function as a pattern to learn from.
Clarification by speech or sign makes the pattern cognitively available.
The explicit example-as-lesson repeats the focus verse's likeness branch.
The explicit admonition repeats the focus verse's pedagogical root.
Learning by making one condition a lesson for another supplies transfer across cases.

structural_cues: 24:34 places a clarified sign, a prior example, and admonition in one sentence.
24:44 names lesson-taking through comparison of changing conditions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated co-occurrence of example, clarification, admonition, and lesson; I infer that 24:17 converts the scandal into a reusable diagnostic pattern. The alternative is that 24:34's example concerns only earlier peoples.

changed_reading.before: God warns against repeating a known wrong.
changed_reading.after: God turns the known wrong into an exemplar so believers can detect and refuse structurally similar recurrences.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the bodily-wound branch of the verb for speaking and joins it to a witnessing tongue. It remains valid as a material analogy because the focus bans renewed analogous action and the context explicitly makes speech an embodied accountable act. Downstream prose should present wound and reopening as an exploratory mechanism, not as the lexical gloss of the sentence.

activation_trace.role: Return supplies the possibility of reopening an earlier effect.
Likeness includes a new utterance that reproduces the earlier injury.
A bodily wound left as a mark materializes the effect of speaking.
The tongue as speech-organ locates the act in the body.
The witnessing tongue makes that embodied trace answerable.

changed_reading.before: Do not say a similar thing again.
changed_reading.after: Do not reopen a wound-like social act whose trace remains in the very organ that transmitted it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ع د د mapping carried by focus ع و د and the same mapped branch under context و ع د. It remains packet-resolvable and is sharpened by an explicit temporal-repetition branch at 24:58. Downstream prose should qualify it as a split-root scheduling image, not as morphology or a replacement translation of تَعُودُوا.

activation_trace.role: A fixed time and its recurrence casts return as a countable recurring slot.
Open duration extends the zero-recurrence demand across every future slot.
The same mapped branch ties a promised future to fixed time and recurrence.
A temporal occurrence and repetition supplies the surah's explicit model of recurring occasions.

changed_reading.before: Make one permanent decision not to repeat it.
changed_reading.after: At every renewed occasion, keep the count of analogous recurrence at zero.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines verbal casting, the spark branch under 'evil,' and the fire-kindling branch under spread. It remains anchored in the focus's return-and-likeness construction and in context branches that explicitly connect accusation with circulation. Downstream prose should retain it as a kinetic fire analogy, not claim that the surface words literally denote sparks.

activation_trace.role: Return makes each renewed ignition a recurrence.
Likeness lets a fragmentary forward reproduce the mechanism without repeating all content.
Casting by speech gives the accusation projectile motion.
Flying sparks supply a branching image for small pieces that carry harm onward.
Kindling a fire with fuel turns circulation into renewed ignition.

changed_reading.before: Do not originate or repeat the whole accusation.
changed_reading.after: Do not throw even a similar fragment or add fuel that rekindles the accusation's spread.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the opening numeral's mapped branch carries tale-bearing that corrupts relations, far from the numeral's surface use. It remains worth carrying because the focus prohibits analogous recurrence and the surah later diagnoses relation-damaging circulation. Downstream prose must identify this as a form-distant packet activation, never as the meaning of 'one hundred.'

activation_trace.role: Return anchors the outlier in renewed conduct.
General likeness permits relation-corrupting tale-bearing to count as an analogous mechanism.
The mapped tale-bearing image unexpectedly places corruption between people inside the opening legal frame.

changed_reading.before: Do not repeat this specific accusation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, do not resume any tale-bearing mechanism that corrupts relations in a comparable way.

strongest_changes: Nonreturn widened from verbatim repetition to renewed participation anywhere in a reception-to-diffusion chain.
Faith became an evidentiary and trust-producing practice: hearing must terminate in warranted judgment and obedience, not relay.
The open-ended ban was scoped to recurrence of the act while the person remains open to reform, purification, pardon, and forgiveness.
The episode became an exemplar whose mechanism can be recognized across later analogous cases.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah reading joined the immediate speech sequence to legal evidence, communal selfhood, privacy thresholds, repair, later hearing-obedience, and explicit example-admonition language. Split-root and material branches also preserved live images of counted recurrence, bodily wounding, thrown sparks, and relation-corrupting tale-bearing.
remaining_uncertainties: The privacy-threshold model depends on a reader-supplied analogy from household entry to communicative entry.
The example and admonition in 24:34 may orient a broader prior-history lesson rather than specifically exemplarize the event around 24:17.
The counted recurrence, spark, wound, and numeral/tale-bearing activations are deliberately form-distant and should remain qualified rather than synthesized as lexical claims.
